doc.title: Architecture Documentation - DeepRock
doc.snippet: Medallion pattern separates data by maturity: bronze (raw, immutable) and silver (processed, application-ready). Silver layer applies business logic, validates quality, enriches metadata. All silver artifacts require created_at, updated_at, and lineage metadata.

artifact.reason: Legacy asset to be migrated. Shows current pattern: depends on content_extraction, uses OpenAI resource, creates summaries with success/failure handling, saves to artifacts/summaries/. This should be refactored to depend on silver_extracted_content and output to silver layer with proper lineage metadata.
Prompt creation logic - should be preserved when migrating to silver_summaries. Generates system and user messages for OpenAI API calls.
Upstream dependency - returns List[dict] with url, type, title, content, metadata, lineage. silver_summaries will iterate over this output to generate summaries for each extracted content item.

Persistence logic for summaries - expects dict with url, status (success/failed), summary, model, tokens_used, latency_ms, error fields. Adds created_at and updated_at timestamps. Saves to artifacts/silver/summaries/ with full SHA256 hash filename.
Asset exports for Dagster discovery - needs to be updated to export silver_summaries instead of (or in addition to) summarization_asset.

constraints.constraint: Use structlog for all logging (not print or context.log) - established pattern in silver layer
Full SHA256 hash (64 chars) for all filenames - NO truncation [:16]
Return plain data structures (List[dict]) - IOManager handles persistence with metadata enrichment
All silver artifacts must include lineage metadata: {"source_asset": "silver_extracted_content", "source_hash": str, "transformation_timestamp": str (ISO 8601)}
Preserve existing prompt creation logic from summarization.py (create_summarization_prompt function)
Track performance metrics: tokens_used and latency_ms for all OpenAI API calls
Handle both success and failure paths - store failed summaries with error metadata (don't skip)
Use RetryPolicy for OpenAI API calls to handle transient failures
Integration tests only - mark with @pytest.mark.integration, located in tests/integration/
Make check must pass (ruff format, ruff check, pytest) before story completion

interface.name: silver_extracted_content output format
interface.signature: List[dict] with {"url": str, "type": "html"|"youtube", "title": str, "content": str, "metadata": dict, "lineage": dict}

interface.name: SilverIOManager expected input for summaries
interface.signature: dict with {"url": str, "status": "success"|"failed", "summary": str|null, "model": str, "tokens_used": int|null, "latency_ms": int|null, "error": str|null, "error_type": str|null, "lineage": {"source_asset": str, "source_hash": str, "transformation_timestamp": str}}

interface.name: OpenAI resource interface
interface.signature: openai.chat_completion(context, messages: list[dict], temperature: float, max_tokens: int) -> response with .usage.total_tokens, .model attributes

interface.name: create_summarization_prompt
interface.signature: create_summarization_prompt(content: dict) -> list[dict[str, str]] (system + user messages)

tests.standards: Integration tests required for all multi-component flows. Mark tests with @pytest.mark.integration and place in tests/integration/ directory. Use PropertyMock on context.op_execution_context.op_config for test configuration injection (established pattern from Story 1.5/1.6). Mock OpenAI API calls for deterministic testing. All tests must pass before story completion - verify with "make check" (runs ruff format, ruff check, pytest). No unit tests required unless complex logic warrants isolation (integration tests preferred per project standards).

test.idea: End-to-end pipeline test: Create bronze cache → materialize silver_extracted_content → materialize silver_summaries → verify summaries saved to artifacts/silver/summaries/ with correct metadata structure (url, status, summary, model, tokens, latency, lineage, timestamps)

Metadata structure validation: Mock OpenAI response → verify summary includes all required fields (url, status, summary, model, tokens_used, latency_ms, lineage with source_asset/source_hash/transformation_timestamp)
Success path test: Mock successful OpenAI API call → verify summary generation, performance tracking (tokens, latency), and correct data structure
Failure path test: Mock OpenAI API exception → verify error handling, error metadata storage (error, error_type), no pipeline halt
Full SHA256 hash filenames: Verify all saved files in artifacts/silver/summaries/ use 64-char SHA256 hash (not truncated [:16])
Manual pipeline integration: Test manual_pipeline job references silver_summaries correctly and produces expected outputs
Monitoring pipeline integration: Test monitoring_pipeline job references silver_summaries correctly
Dependency verification: Test silver_summaries receives List[dict] from silver_extracted_content with expected structure
